name: Fossil Crown
storyline: You inherit an old ranch in a prehistoric valley. Dig up fossils, hatch eggs, tame the wild dinos that wander through your gate and train a team to climb the arena ranking. When the time comes, call the meteor: send your best dinos to the Museum and start a new journey, stronger than before.
summary: Fossil Crown is an idle dinosaur game for PC. Build your ranch, hatch eggs, tame wild dinos at the gate, send them on expeditions and fight in the ranked arena. Free to play, coming soon to Steam.
